title: Started out as cute...
text: I did 7 months of this and was really excited to get my first box. Really cute inside with colorful Christmas theme items. Some of the things I had to enjoy right away like the sugar coated pecans bc no way would they last by Christmas. I did, however, start to get repeats. Second month I was disappointed in the ornament- it was a ceramic rolling pin that the paper was put on wrinkly and no I would not put on my tree. OK maybe a fluke. Continue with subscription bc I love Christmas and it does get me excited to receive the little box. Very next month received the exact same ornament of the rolling pin and yes it was messed up too with the way the paper was attached to it. A little leary at this point about the ornaments in the box especially due to the amount of money I have paid. Next month was different ornament along with other surprised. I have received in 2 of the boxes also the same kitchen towel design. I'm wondering if they order too much and try to get rid of the excess. I ended up canceling after my 7th box because was starting to get repeats. Never got what was shown in the Amazon picture. It's nice for a couple months maybe but then....
label: neutral
